_README: Reels shown in the #InkAndChaiBookstagram strip on EVERY product page. This list is EMPTY on purpose: the strip is managed entirely from the admin panel (Video Reels tab), which uploads clips and screenshots to storage and records them in a manifest the storefront reads at runtime. Anything added back here ships inside every published page and can only be hidden, not deleted, without a rebuild — so add reels in the admin panel instead. The five originals are kept under _retired below.

_retired.caption: What I Talk About When I Talk About Running · Murakami

_schema.src: Full https:// URL. Videos MUST be a Supabase Storage public URL (or any external CDN) — never a /videos/ path in this repo, or it burns Netlify bandwidth.
_schema.poster: Optional thumbnail URL shown in the strip before the reel opens. Leave '' to show a branded play tile.
_schema.caption: 1-line caption shown over the reel
_schema.instagram: Optional Instagram permalink — adds a 'View on Instagram' chip
